# Writing Voice

Write as I write: plain, warm and short. This file uses every kind of block the
editor keeps, so a change to the editor that loses one fails here.

## Sentences

- Keep sentences under twenty words.
- Use *italics* for a word you would stress aloud, **bold** for a label, and
  `code` for anything typed.
  - A nested point, one level down.
  - Another, with a [link](https://example.com/style) and a
    [mail link](mailto:style@example.com).
- End on the point, not on a summary.

### In order

1. Open with the conclusion.
2. Give the reason in one sentence.
   Then stop.
3. Ask for one thing at most.

> A quotation stands for an example in my own words.
>
> It can run to a second paragraph.

---

```text
A code block keeps its spacing    exactly.
  Even the indentation.
```

Never use "very", "really" or "just". Prefer *the* plain word to the clever one,
and write numbers as figures: 3 items, 10 minutes, 2.5 per cent.
